title: Canada map: every heart pin wins its tap
kaylee: Tapping any heart pin on the Canada map opens that place, even when an animal, the balloon or another place sits on top of it.

pictures.title: Why taps went missing (iPhone)
pictures.caption: Red: the animals' tap boxes. They sat over the pins and caught the taps. The orca covered the whole whale-scene pin. Now a pin always wins.
